meta.title: Cristian Puentes — Full Stack Developer
meta.description: Full stack developer building real products end to end — from the interface down to the server they run on.

hero.sub: Django, Next.js and Postgres by day — lately, everything from self-hosted infrastructure to healthcare booking systems. I like owning the whole stack, servers included.

chohealth.name: CHOHEALTH
chohealth.tagline: Healthcare booking, self-hosted end to end
chohealth.description: A booking platform that lets clinics manage appointments, medical records and payments — built and deployed end to end, from the Django API down to the server it runs on.
chohealth.problem: Small clinics were juggling paper schedules and three disconnected tools for booking, billing and records — nothing talked to each other, and double-bookings were routine.

choplanner.name: CHO Planner
choplanner.description: A personal task and note manager with a swappable AI assistant — Claude, GPT or Gemini — that breaks goals into weighted subtasks and optionally syncs with Google Calendar. Local-first: it works fully without any external service.

neurostock.name: Neurostock
neurostock.tagline: Stock price prediction with LSTM neural networks
neurostock.description: Predicts stock prices for any ticker using an LSTM neural network trained on historical data, with Monte Carlo Dropout for uncertainty estimation and strict data-leakage prevention between training and test sets.

sevenlever.name: Seven Lever
sevenlever.description: A local two-player dice game based on "Seven Eleven", the game played in Colombian schoolyards — bets, a life bar, and an animated loss sequence, all live in the frontend.
